purpose: Teach: 栄誉/誤字/身辺/原資/無形/物欲/申し込む/差し出す

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員に栄誉を与える表彰制度を整えろ
lines.en: I want us to establish a proper commendation system that honors our staff.
lines.style: Brisk, commanding. Cuts straight to the point. Weight on 整えろ — this is directive, not suggestion. Composed authority, no inflection wasted.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。誤字脱字の校正を徹底します
lines.en: Understood. I'll ensure we cover all the details thoroughly.
lines.style: Crisp acknowledgment. Quick intake of breath before the 「はい」 — ready to move. Efficient, respectful. No flourish, just confirmation of receipt.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、役員の身辺セキュリティを強化しろ
lines.en: Strengthen the personal security protocols for our executives.
lines.style: Same authority as before. Steady pulse underneath. This is non-negotiable. Slight emphasis on 強化しろ to signal severity without raising volume.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。投資の原資を再点検します
lines.en: Yes. I'll recheck our capital allocation and funding sources.
lines.style: Quick nod. Hands already moving to take notes mentally. Practical, no hesitation. The sound of someone already three steps ahead.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 無形資産の評価方法を見直せ
lines.en: Review our approach to valuing intangible assets.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful. This one requires more deliberation — the pace slows slightly. Still commanding, but the 見直せ lands with precision rather than force.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の物欲に頼らない動機付けを検討します
lines.en: Understood. I'll look into non-material incentive strategies for our people.
lines.style: Serious uptake. Recognizes this one matters — there's weight in how he processes it. Still efficient, but slightly slower. Shows he's engaged with the nuance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新業務を申し込む顧客への対応を磨け
lines.en: Polish our approach to customers inquiring about new services.
lines.style: Shift to customer-facing now. Still directive, but the tone opens slightly — this is about impression, execution. 磨け has finesse underneath the command.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様に手を差し出す姿勢を徹底します
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure we extend ourselves fully to our clients.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Slightly longer pause — this one lands differently, more resonance. 姿勢を徹底 suggests he understands this is about culture, not just process. Warmer but still professional.
